change.describe: branch `pr-94942` of grafana-94942 against cbe1e7d63f098e306058c0fbcab2f5c30602fa7d (merge-base cbe1e7d)
change.title: pr-94942
change.author: Sam Jewell

findings.title: enableSqlExpressions always returns false and ignores the feature flag
findings.body: `enabled := !IsEnabledGlobally(...)` is inverted, and both branches then `return false`. The helper is a constant `false`, so the `sqlExpressions` toggle has no effect and the flag name misleads. It also reads like a bug, since a true `enabled` returns false. If the aim is to hard-disable SQL expressions until the DuckDB-free implementation exists, drop the helper and return the error directly at `pkg/expr/reader.go:129-132`. If the flag should still gate the feature, return `h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions)`. The `db.go` stub already returns errors, so the flag would not enable anything real yet.

findings.title: Disabling is applied only in the ExpressionQueryReader path, not the legacy node path
findings.body: The check is added only in `ReadQuery`, which `pkg/expr/nodes.go:123-143` uses only when `FlagExpressionParser` is on. With that flag off, `pkg/expr/nodes.go:159-160` still calls `UnmarshalSQLCommand`, then `NewSQLCommand`, then the stub `sql.TablesList`. That fails with a generic 'error reading SQL command' (`pkg/expr/sql_command.go:33-35`), and the real cause ('not implemented') is only logged as a warning. The result is still an error rather than a silent wrong answer. The two paths do give different messages for the same query, though: the reader says 'sqlExpressions is not implemented', the legacy path says 'sql-invalid-sql'. Consider gating once, at the shared entry point, or making the message consistent.

findings.title: Stub DB with duck-style API keeps dead call sites that always fail
findings.body: All three `DB` methods return 'not implemented', but `parser.go:23-26` and `sql_command.go:96-100` still build and run queries through them. `TablesList` therefore always returns an error. `SQLCommand.Execute` always returns `rsp.Error`. The `parser_test.go` and `sql_command_test.go` tests were already skipped at the base commit, so they cannot flag this. This is acceptable as a temporary removal of go-duck. A TODO or comment on `DB` saying it is a deliberate placeholder would stop the dead code and the `duckDB` variable name in `parser.go:23` from being mistaken for a working path.

findings.title: Dependency removals depend on `make update-workspace` being run
findings.body: The PR body says to run `make update-workspace`. The go.work.sum changes show that `JohnCGriffin/overflow`, `apache/thrift`, `klauspost/asmfmt` and `minio/asm2plan9s` and `c2goasm` moved from go.sum to go.work.sum. That is consistent with go-duck being removed from `go.mod`. I did not run the Go tooling, so I cannot confirm that `go mod tidy` and `go work sync` produce exactly this state.

contracts.action: SQL expression query type is rejected in ExpressionQueryReader.ReadQuery
contracts.equivalent_path: pkg/expr/nodes.go:159-160 (legacy UnmarshalSQLCommand path when FlagExpressionParser is off)
contracts.before_after: Before: SQL queries were parsed and executed via go-duck. After: the reader path returns 'sqlExpressions is not implemented' unconditionally. The legacy path reaches the stub `sql.TablesList`, which returns an error that `NewSQLCommand` converts to a BadRequest 'error reading SQL command'.
contracts.visible_effect: The user gets an error for any SQL expression. The message differs between the two paths.
contracts.failure_mode: The error is returned, not silent. The legacy path hides the real cause from the user and logs it only as a warning.

contracts.before_after: Before: frames were queried in DuckDB. After: it always returns an error, which is set as rsp.Error with a nil returned error.
contracts.visible_effect: The query result for the SQL node carries an error; it is not a panic.
contracts.failure_mode: The error is reported through rsp.Error and logged. Execute is effectively unreachable in practice because construction already fails in `TablesList`.

summary: The PR removes go-duck and stubs the SQL DB layer, so SQL expressions always fail. `enableSqlExpressions` in `pkg/expr/reader.go` is inverted and unconditionally returns false, so it ignores the `sqlExpressions` toggle and reads like a bug. The check also covers only the `ExpressionQueryReader` path. The legacy `UnmarshalSQLCommand` path fails later through the stub, with a different and vaguer user-facing error. The `parser_test.go` and `sql_command_test.go` tests were already skipped at the base, so none of them exercise the stub. Dependency removals in go.mod, go.sum and go.work.sum look consistent with dropping go-duck, but I could not run the Go tooling to confirm they match what `make update-workspace` would produce.
